text:
Alex L: Heads-up — bank POC (IslandBank) says fully air-gapped. They need details on packaging, upgrade cadence, and any billing hiccups. Can we outline what we can and can’t do for a sealed environment?

Priya S: We can deliver a signed offline bundle (tar.gz) + manifest + sha256 sums. Supports chunked transfer for limited-bandwidth transfers. For customers with HSM we can provide unsigned artifacts + verification metadata so they can sign locally. :white_check_mark:

Jordan M: Quick clarifying q: do we support delta upgrades or only full bundle replacement? They explicitly called out "monthly security patches" but zero outbound connectivity.

Priya S: We support incremental deltas (patch bundles) that the on‑prem operator applies in sequence. For strict air-gap the ops team runs our offline upgrader tool locally. Hotpatching without at least a service restart is not supported. Typical recommended cadence: monthly security deltas + quarterly feature rollups (can compress to quarterly-only on request).

Sam R: Pricing note — offline packaging & signed-bundle delivery is an additional engineering service for POCs (ballpark 8–16 engineering hours). Ongoing per-bundle signing or on-call validation is billable. Reserved Dedicated capacity (if they want private GPUs on-prem) follows our enterprise reserved pricing.

Alex L: Security questionnaire from the bank asks for SBOM, CVE response process, cert rotation cadence, and KMS/HSM integration pattern. Who can own those answers?

Priya S: I’ll draft SBOM and CVE/process responses and the offline verification steps. We need Security to provide KMS/HSM and cert rotation text (we can offer BYOK guidance but exact integration depends on their vendor).

InfraOps Bot: package-builder: artifact 4072468000-islbank-v1 signed -> staging. checksum: sha256:3f7a9c2e... (triggered by @Priya S)

Jordan M: Potential legal blocker — export-control and crypto clauses. Sales/legal please flag for SOW. Some banks insist on special export language for signed artifacts.

Sam R: Operational constraint worth noting — some customers require an on-site upgrade verification window (we validate an upgrade on a staging appliance on their network). If they require that, plan +2–4 days in rollout and add an SOW line for on-site validation.

Alex L: Action items: 1) Priya — prepare SBOM, CVE/process doc, and offline verification checklist. 2) Security — supply KMS/HSM and cert rotation wording. 3) Sales/Legal — add export-control language to draft SOW. 4) Infra — estimate eng hours for initial POC package + delta automation.

Priya S: I'll assemble a short FAQ + checklist and send to Emily (IslandBank PKI lead) today. Need to know if they accept Redwood signing or require BYO key, and the size/throughput of their transport (for chunking strategy).

Jordan M: Customer PKI contact: emily.t@islandbank.com. Also ask whether they want monthly sec patches or only quarterly rollups — that'll change ops + SOW.

Alex L: Thanks team — if we need a quick sync with IslandBank, I can do a call tomorrow 10am PT. Ping me if anything urgent. :phone:
